title: Chapter 510
paragraphs: Chapter 510
141. Crash (3)
On March 5th, 1800, a day had passed since those who participated in the 'Sota Desert' special mission returned to the Sword Garden.
The mission was successful, but the losses were significant.
"We saved him, but his arm… The necrosis and tissue loss were too severe; there was nothing we could do," said the medical director in a heavy voice, referring to Mon.

Although they managed to retrieve Mon's severed arm after the battle with Bianca, the participants in the Sota Desert mission had fought several more battles with the Federation's navy after crossing the central boundary line of Lutero.
His arm was already in a hopeless state at the end of the battle with Bianca if it didn't receive treatment at the level of the Holy King.
"Will he be able to perform missions in the future?" asked Jin, suppressing his boiling anger.
His question wasn't asked out of concern for Mon's wasted talent as the top asset of the family. It was out of hope that Mon's self-imposed purpose and pride would be maintained.
"Except for his left arm, the rest will recover perfectly soon. Although it might be difficult as a Black Knight, I think he can perform all missions at a lower level."
"…Thank you for your hard work, Medical Director."
"Go and see him. He's awake."
Entering the operating room, Mon was seen wrapped in bandages and medical equipment.
"Knight Mon."
After returning, Jin had heard from Zed that Mon and Jane were lovers.
"12th generation."

Mon didn't speak for a while, his gaze fixed on the window. In contrast to the hazy sky of the Sota Desert, which was filled with battle smoke during the mission, the sun was shining brightly, coloring the patient's room.
"It's inevitable that I'll be demoted to a Guardian Knight or Executioner. With this arm, I'd only be a burden to the other Black Helmets."
"Without you, the mission would not have been successful."
"It's nice weather."
Mon neither affirmed nor denied Jin's words, but he was thinking about the story he had heard from Jin on the way back.
"Don't be too downhearted. The Black Helmet is just… a symbol of loyalty to the family. Even without it, my nature will not change. However."
Mon turned his head toward Jin and continued.
"If what you said is true… If it really is, then I think things have changed."
The expression "changed" referred not to himself but to the Sword Garden.
-The 7th Final Battle Device, Volcano. The 2nd generation must have faced death for sure…
-No, they must be alive. The one who unleashed the volcano was not the real Joshua but his clone.
-Clone?
-Youngest, what are you talking about?

As they escaped from the Lutero Magic Federation, Jin informed his party that Joshua was likely a clone. Although the claim was not yet proven, Difus and Mon could not shake off their uneasy intuition.
"12th generation."
"Speak."
"Jane actually wanted to serve you. And the moment your words are proven..."
At that moment, someone entered the treatment room. It was Jin's servant, Petro.
"Master!"
Jin instinctively knew why Petro had come so urgently. Mon also sensed the same.
"The 2nd generation has returned…!"
As soon as Petro finished speaking, a tremendous energy burst from Mon.
The entire building shook from the immense power, almost unbelievable coming from someone who was on the brink of death just a day ago.
Bloody tears flowed from Mon's eyes. Soon, he retracted his power, got up from the bed, and looked at Jin.
"Hurry, 12th generation."
They headed out with determination.
Outside the iron gate, Joshua was standing. He was in perfect shape, without a single scratch, leading all his direct knights except for the Black Knight.
The black sword, a flag with the symbol of Runcandel.
Both the knights outside the gate who came with Joshua and those who gathered inside the garden held the same flag.
The scene was disgustingly appalling.
"Your words were true."
Difus stood next to Jin and spoke. Jin could feel Difus barely suppressing his anger.
"Jin."
"Yes, brother."
"We must bring him down and kill him. And if Mother protects that disgusting man again, we will never let it go."
Rebellion.
Or reform.
Difus made up his mind.
Jin did the same. However, unlike Difus, Jin was almost certain that his arrogant elder brother would have a hard time avoiding responsibility this time.
Looking at the knights standing behind Joshua, Jin's conviction deepened.
'He must have brought his knights out of fear. But does he still not know that the knights of the family, even if not the hunting dogs, are loyal not to him but...'
Bringing the knights to the Sword Garden was a perfect mistake.
Joshua should have come alone. That's what Jin thought, and their mother, Rosa, who came out of the main building, thought the same.
Snap!
The knights formed a row. Rosa, who walked through the row, had an indifferent look in her eyes.
"2nd generation of the family, Joshua Runcandel. I have completed my mission and returned!"
His voice, barely holding on to confidence, lacked dignity. There was no pride in having successfully completed a difficult mission.
It was just the fear of a son who couldn't be sure whether he would be punished or rewarded by his mother.
He believed that he would receive an award as always before coming to the Sword Garden.
No, he wanted to believe it. However, as soon as he faced Rosa's cold face, Joshua felt his hope fading. Children often can't handle their parents' expressions when they're different from usual.
Joshua was even rationalizing that he had brought the knights with him.
It wasn't because he was afraid of Rosa's decision, but merely a device to show off the dignity of the next head of the family who had fiercely completed the mission and returned.
"I received a report that you died during the mission. What happened?"
No matter how much he rationalized, Joshua knew from the first word that his mother wasn't welcoming his return.
It was time to face the painful reality.
"Mother, that's..."
"Address me properly. I'm not standing here as your mother right now."
Joshua's pupils widened.
The others watching were also shocked. It was the first time Rosa had stepped on Joshua's authority in front of everyone like this, outside of debates.
"I apologize... Acting Head. I made a mistake."
"Clearly explain to me how Joshua Lundkendal, the second heir, is standing here and not dead."
Why did you survive, you should have died there.
That's what Joshua heard from Rosa's words. He couldn't help but tremble at the sound of his mother's voice, filled with malice beyond mere reproach.
"Answer me, it's not like the fourth and twelfth heirs dared to lie to me!"
When Rosa shouted again, a heavy air pressure occurred all around.
"I, I survived because..."
He stammered. His pupils trembled, and Joshua felt himself shrinking. The eyes of the family members watching him were filled with deep contempt.
"I sent a... clone... on the mission..."
At that point, Jin thought:
'Not only did he make the meaningless mistake of bringing the knights, but Joshua also missed the last chance to change Mother's mind.'
Joshua didn't know why his mother was so angry.
It was because he had forgotten the essence.
Huuuu!
Joshua caught his breath and looked up at Rosa. But he couldn't hide his trembling legs.
"I survived because I sent a clone created through the prophet on the mission. As a result, the mission was successful."
"One Black Knight met death, and another was crippled. Can you call that a success?"
The superficial reason Joshua was being rebuked now was precisely that. Mon survived, but in effect, Lundkendal lost two Black Knights in this mission.
Joshua had to take responsibility as the highest commander of the mission.
But the real reason Rosa was doing this was different.
The essence of Lundkendal, the struggle. Joshua forgot it. Maybe he never had it in the first place.
The method wasn't important.
Even if he used a fake body for the mission, and as a result, one Black Knight died and another was crippled, even if it caused a greater loss.
Joshua should have struggled. As the next head of the family, he should have raised the value of the family.
Instead of trembling like a frightened dog or a scared child, he should have proven that he was never wrong.
He should have confronted Rosa and the family.

"Should I have had a better plan than using the prophet's power and the clone? If there was a better way, why didn't you say anything? Who really caused the death of the family's Black Knight?" I should have roared those words.
Like Jin did at the time of the family head declaration.
"If you had shown that you didn't forget the essence of the Runcandel, Mother would have hesitated this time as well."
For Jin, it was a disgusting feeling, as if he wanted to throw up.
Of all the Runcandels present at this moment and all their children, he was the one who understood the character of Rosa Runcandel the deepest. His teeth chattered at this fact.
"I made... a mistake."
Rosa's eyes became even colder.
Why?
Why... don't you accept me?
I certainly succeeded in the mission for the family, and Mother has been tacitly approving my use of the prophet's power and the clone until now....
Am I not your most beloved child?
Joshua's head was filled with such thoughts. The essence of Joshua Runcandel was nothing more than a child struggling to be recognized by his parents.
That could not be called a struggle.
"Fourth generation."
"Yes, acting family head."
"Tell me, did you know that the second generation sent a clone?"
"I didn't know."
"Twelfth generation, what about you?"
"I had a suspicion."
"But then, why was the sacrifice of the Black Knights necessary for this mission, not just his clone?"
"As I reported yesterday, it's because our family invested the least among the three major powers in this matter. However..."
Jin looked down at Joshua and continued.

"If he had shared all the information with me and the fourth generation from the beginning, and had volunteered for the sacrifice of the clone in advance. There would have been no need for Black Knight Jane to die, and Mon to lose his arm."
"Mother, no! That's just a hypothetical! I'll explain everything, my plan was perfect, it's just that there were too many variables in this mission...!"
A smile more scornful than contempt appeared at the corner of Rosa's mouth.
"Black Sword Society, restrain Joshua Runcandel."
"By your command!"
The ones who responded to Rosa's order were not those inside the garden, but the knights Joshua had brought with him.
All of Joshua's top-ranked knights, excluding the Black Knights, were members of the Runcandel Elder Council's Punishment Squad. Joshua himself had only just found out about this fact.
"Raine, Bex, Rihanna... even Sinatra. All of you... were part of the Black Sword Society...!"

The Punishers of the Black Sword Society, who had revealed their identities, removed the Infi masks from their faces. As the old, disfigured faces that were unrecognizable from their original appearances were revealed, everyone in the room held their breath.
"From this moment, Joshua Runcandel's second-generation family qualifications are suspended. Also, a secret bounty is placed on his original body and all clones, which may be active outside."
"Imprison him in the underground dungeon."
"Mother, Mother...!"
A fall.
Everyone watching Joshua Runcandel cry out for his mother was reminded of that word.
